note: Planted errors for the claims canary and calibration suite (D21.1, AC-7.5). None restates misconceptions[]. Which job is which lives only in $PTK_STATE/claims-private/.

mutations.find: factorial(3) cannot finish line 7 until factorial(2) returns a value, so its frame waits above the new one.
mutations.replace: factorial(3) finishes line 7 first and then calls factorial(2), so its frame is gone before the new one starts.
mutations.why_false: The multiplication needs the call's value, which exists only after factorial(2) returns (6.8.6.4p3).

mutations.find: Each call to factorial gets its own n and its own r.
mutations.replace: Every call to factorial shares one n and one r.
mutations.why_false: A block entered recursively gets a new instance of each automatic object (6.2.4p6).

mutations.find: Each factorial return hands its value to the call that made it, one frame up.
mutations.replace: Each factorial return hands its value straight to main, skipping the frames in between.
mutations.why_false: A return gives its value to its caller (6.8.6.4p3), which is the frame above it in the drawing.

mutations.find: In factorial(1), n > 1 is false, so r stays 1 and it returns 1.
mutations.replace: In factorial(1), n > 1 is true, so r becomes 1 * factorial(0) and it returns 1.
mutations.why_false: With n = 1 the test n > 1 is false and line 7 is skipped; factorial(0) is never called.

mutations.find: The calls start in the order 3, 2, 1, and they finish in the reverse order: 1, 2, 3.
mutations.replace: Every recursive function finishes its calls in the reverse of the order it starts them.
mutations.why_false: Only nested calls like these finish last-in first-out; sibling recursive calls (for example two calls in one body) finish in their own order.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 9899:2018 (C17), working draft N2176
sources.quote: A break statement terminates execution of the smallest enclosing switch or iteration statement.

mutations.why_false: The break clause says nothing about objects in recursive calls; the claim rests on 6.2.4p6.
